services.name: Home safety assessment

services.name: Workplace assessment
services.story: A workplace assessment. Nothing is taken, and the business bills the employer its own way.

services_shape: visit types in the clinic's treatment room, or at a home or a workplace, each with a set length; an assessment is a history, a check of daily tasks, and a plan of care; a plan of care's sessions are booked as a series only with the patient's own yes, and each is paid when it happens; a home visit checks the home and gives a written list, and no work is done on the home by Rosie's team
questions_before_times: for you, or for your child (a parent or guardian books a child, who stays)
new or returning patient (a new patient gets the 60-minute new assessment)
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only, never a condition typed into the AI
a car accident or a work injury (then it's billed to that claim)
a health plan (its name only), or paying yourself
safety_stop: a sudden face droop, arm or leg weakness, trouble speaking, or sudden confusion; or a fall with a hit to the head and trouble waking
a gas smell, smoke, or a fire at a home or a workplace visit
a wound that's red, hot and getting worse, or a fever with new swelling
first_steps: The claim for a car accident or a work injury
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
The referral, where the plan or the state asks for one
The employer's OK for a workplace visit
license: each OT holds their own state license; the clinic where the state's form asks
staff_skills: clinicians: assessments, plans of care, splint fittings, home and workplace assessments, child sessions; the front desk: check-in, plan checks, estimates and payment; only people cleared for home and workplace visits go out
messages_never: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the condition, the visit type, the reason, the plan, or the clinician's name (at home or at work, the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
